name: Flooded Cave
description: A dark cave partially filled with water. The sound of dripping water echoes throughout.

entrance.name: Cave Entrance
entrance.description: The entrance to the cave, where light from outside barely reaches.

water_pool.name: Water Pool
water_pool.description: A shallow pool of water fills this part of the cave. The water is clear but cold.
water_pool.look_around: Something glints at the bottom of the pool, just out of reach.

narrow_passage.name: Narrow Passage
narrow_passage.description: A tight passageway that seems to lead deeper into the cave system.
